ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.3.4 (TieJin Modify) 新增完整战斗员特化：性奴培养、调教与直接击杀经验、人格凝胶终极化及战斗超频。 新增普通特化进度测试按钮与专属技能图标；整理特化名称和状态颜色，统一四语说明。 修复人格排泄被普通工作／需求任务中断，以及多个执行者争抢同一目标的问题。 基于上游 2.2.8 继续维护，包含 2.3.3 及更早版本内容。 锁链达到第 2 阶段的 SSC 性奴可按 RJW 原有条件被指派为泄欲对象；见习性奴不因此获得资格。 旧 RimTalk 兼容继续暂停，宠物猫、宠物兔未完成入口继续禁用。 完整中英双语更新记录见 CHANGELOG.md。
Version 2.3.4 adds the complete Combatant specialization: Training and direct-kill progression, personality gel finalization and Combat Overdrive. Adds an ordinary-specialization progress testing command and a dedicated ability icon, with clearer specialization labels, colors and four-language descriptions. Fixes personality excretion interrupted by automatic work or need jobs, and prevents competing initiators from taking the same target. Continues development from upstream 2.2.8, including 2.3.3 and earlier content. SSC sex slaves at Chain stage 2 or higher can be designated as RJW Comfort pawns under RJW's existing conditions; trainees gain no eligibility from SSC identity alone. Legacy RimTalk remains suspended; unfinished Pet Cat and Pet Rabbit choices remain disabled. See CHANGELOG.md for the full Chinese and English notes.
